headlines.text: On this day in 2026, Jon Moxley vs. Bandido went to battle over the AEW Continental Title, appearing on Forbidden Door, rated 8.33 ? an excellent showing. Moxley choked out Bandido to retain the AEW Continental Title in a hard-fought technical battle.

2023 brought us this moment: Allin & Sting vs. Guevara & Jericho fought it out in a Tornado Tag match, topping the bill that night on Dynamite, rated 7.25 ? a solid showing in a physical tag team battle.

That Sunday in 2026, a new chapter began as Shota Umino vs. PAC fought for the brand-new IWGP Global Heavyweight Title, appearing on Forbidden Door, rated 7.58 ? a match that delivered. Umino successfully defended the IWGP Global Heavyweight Championship against PAC.

secondaries.text: That Sunday in 2026, Starlight Kid made their first appearance under the AEW banner against Thekla, appearing on Forbidden Door, rated 7.66 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle. Thekla, a former STARDOM outcast on a personal crusade against her old promotion, survived a pair of Divine Punishments and a top-rope moonsault before a spear and two curbstomps retained her title ? then cut off Starlight Kid's mask with scissors, spat on it, and used it to beat down watching STARDOM president Taro Okada.

In a war that turned into an absolute bloodbath, Ospreay finally put away Strickland with a Tiger Driver '96 to win the Men's Owen Hart Cup and punch his ticket to Wembley.
